card.name: Words just before a dose to adjust
card.fires_on: Small words such as "the" or "lower" placed right before "dose" or "dosage" in drug-interaction advice, after verbs like reduce, limit or increase. Also the digit 1 at the start of a dose range.

modes.label: Word before dose
modes.description: "the" or "lower" sits between an adjusting verb or article and the word dose of another drug.
